name: Glarun Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Glarun Technology Co.,Ltd operates in the computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing industry in China and internationally. The company offers radar equipment and related systems products for international operations, military electronics, public meteorology, emergency management, transportation, water conservancy, and power. It also provides industrial software and digital solutions products, such as automatic train protection system, automatic train control, data communication system, NGTT-1A type 3-out-of-2 secure computer platform, tram operation and dispatch system, intersection control system, turnout control system, vehicle control system, obstacle detection…
